svg.title: Illustrative document graph from explicit note links
svg.desc: Inside one selected root, a project brief explicitly links to a storage policy with a decision relationship. The policy explicitly links to a storage check as evidence and an implementation work note as work. An unresolved depends_on reference produces a link_missing diagnostic, not a missing-note node. These are authored references, not inferred relationships or proof of factual correctness; inspection is read-only.
